main_text.p: כמונא Chald. Cyminum, Κύμινον. Jesa. 28.27. Syrè כמטהן, Matth.23.23.
כמץ כומצא Ch. Fossa, fovea, Jesa. 24.18. Jer.48.43. 44. Idem quod גומצא.

כמר Niphal נכמר Heb. Incalescere, calefieri, æstuare. Juxta hanc significationem explicant illud in Targum, Psal.77.10. מלמכמר רחמוי Ut non incalescat viscera misericordiæ ejus. Respondet ibi Hebraeo קפץ, unde Elias in Thisbi exponit, Continere, concludere: sed diversa ibi à Meturgeman lectio. Priorem expositionem confirmat locus Deuteron.13.18. in Targum Jonath. ויכמור עליכון רחמין Ut efstuet super vos commiserationibus. Respondet Hebr. ונתן, ut det, conferat. Ethpeh. Syr. ܐܬܟܡܪ Triftitiâ, Dolore affici, cōtristari, mœstū fieri, Mar.10.22. Matt.26.27.
כמיא Syr. Tristis, mœstus, tetricus, atratus. Plural.
כומרא, כומרא Ch. & Syr. Sacerdos, sacrificulus, gentilis sc. & idololatricus, monachus. Plur. כומרין, כומריא, Syre, Princeps Sacerdotum, Summus sacerdos, ad Heb.2.17.
כומרן Ch. Idem. Plur. כומרניא Genef.39.20. & 47.22. in Targ.Jon.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; several Syriac and pointed Hebrew forms are only approximate and should be checked against the original. The Syriac vocalised forms in the first lines are uncertain.
